title: Mobility Equipment Rental Period Values — Breaks in Need and New Coverage Entry
content:
# Rental Period Values Card — Mobility Equipment

Three values per Mobility Equipment class govern whether a capped rental continues in the same rental period or starts again.

- **Break in need** — the days of a break in need, beyond the days left in the rental month in which it began, after which a new rental period starts.
- **New period requirements** — what a new rental period after a long break needs.
- **Payer entry requalification** — what a rental needs when a new primary coverage starts paying.

| Class | Break in need (days) | New rental period after a long break needs | When a new primary coverage starts paying, the rental needs |
|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Manual Wheelchair (K0001) | 60 | a new order | a new order |
| Lightweight Manual Wheelchair (K0003) | 60 | a new order | a new order |
| High-Strength Lightweight Wheelchair (K0004) | 60 | a new order | a new order |
| Ultralightweight Manual Wheelchair (K0005) | 60 | a new order | a new order and an evaluation |
| Group 2 Standard Power Wheelchair (K0823) | 60 | a new order and a face-to-face examination | a new order and a face-to-face examination |
| Group 3 Complex Rehab Power Wheelchair (K0856) | 60 | a new order and a face-to-face examination | a new order and a face-to-face examination |

## Reading the card

- The break in need is 60 days for every class.
- After a long break the three lighter manual classes and K0005 need only a new order; the two power classes need a new order and a face-to-face examination.
- On entry of a new primary coverage, K0005 is the one class needing a new order and an evaluation; K0823 and K0856 need a new order and a face-to-face examination; the other classes need a new order.
